dataset.description: This DMP serves as a comprehensive guide for managing the data generated during the POLYCONNECT project. The POLYCONNECT project studies the implementation of optical polymer waveguides on printed circuit boards (PCBs) to develop high-capacity on-board optical interconnects for efficient data routing and transmission. The goal of the POLYCONNECT project is to demonstrate Polymer Photonic Interconnects for High-density Data Centers on line card PCB prototypes for low power consumption and high-speed multichannel data transmission. The DMP outlines how we will handle, store, share, and preserve the data collected, ensuring it supports the project's objectives and is accessible for future research and development. The POLYCONNECT project will generate and collect a variety of data crucial for advancing polymer photonics technology. Specifically, the datasets will include data analysis. The data will also be stored in various formats.

distribution.title: The purpose of data collection and generation in the POLYCONNECT project is to support the design, fabrication, optimization, and experimental validation of polymer photonic interconnects integrated on printed circuit boards (PCBs) for high-density data center applications.
